name: Topkapi Palace (Saray-ı Hümayun)
description: Grand imperial administrative and residential palace of the Ottoman Sultans overlooking the Bosphorus and Golden Horn.
history: Served as the administrative center and royal residence of the Ottoman Empire for nearly 400 years from 1465 to 1856 CE.
construction: Spans four cascading courtyards with pavilions, the Imperial Harem, treasury, and the Chamber of Holy Relics.
architecture: Features classic Ottoman Iznik tilework, mother-of-pearl inlay, and the iconic Tower of Justice.
significance: UNESCO World Heritage Site as part of the Historic Areas of Istanbul.
